countedBy: lane #201 (opus) from the rectified Gemeente Amsterdam panorama crops (CC BY 4.0) before the model was rendered; the integrator may re-count. One window is one opening (a multi-pane frame with a heavy transom is one window); the bay windows on consoles are left out of the crops; the dormer band counts each framed light.

facades.name: Postjesweg school wing (eight axes between the end bays)
facades.note: w02-354 x 180-1715: basement lights under every axis, then three floors of wide cream multi-pane windows (5x3, 5x4, 5x3 panes); the end bays with their erkers are cropped off.

facades.name: Postjeswetering water front (south-west, five axes)
facades.note: w04-209: five axes: basement row, first floor with its low row of panes under a heavy transom (one window), second floor, and two dormer lights per axis in the mansard band. No 'columns' count: the two dormer lights per axis sit between the window axes below.

calibration: alongM crops placed by the model's mirror-symmetry optimum (sweep of +-1.2 m) after matching the photo crop's ends; the photo counts were written before the model existed and were not changed.
